official_metric: global_wp_clip2_v1 over pooled scored rows with target clipping +/-2 and absolute clipped target weights

membership.source: explicit fold0.json fit.valid and evaluation.valid row-group lists joined to valid_targets.npz row_group in target order

selection_labels.fit_valid_in_sample: reused labels from the 1,405 valid groups included in fitting; in-sample diagnostic
selection_labels.eval_exposed: the 468 fixed F0 evaluation groups; repeatedly inspected exposed development evidence, not fresh confirmation

membership.row_mask: frozen valid_targets mask AND row index >= 99

limits: Descriptive reuse of fitting groups versus exposed evaluation groups; no causal generalization, fresh-CV or public-transfer claim.
Official metric scores are streamed by batches through the unchanged GlobalAccumulator; fixed-prediction/one-seed evidence only.
Raw target mean/RMS are unweighted and un-clipped; prediction exceedance is the fraction of scored rows with absolute raw prediction greater than two.
